name: Isuzu / Isuzu UTE
overview: From providing the foundation for the Holden Gemini and Holden Rodeo to dominating Australian ute and SUV sales with the D-MAX and MU-X.
australian_history:
Isuzu's history in Australia began in the mid-1960s with small-scale imports of the Bellett and Florian sedans. The brand's true impact arrived in 1971 when General Motors acquired a 34% stake in Isuzu Japan, initiating a four-decade engineering partnership with General Motors-Holden in Australia.

In 1975, Holden adapted the Isuzu Gemini (T-car) to create the beloved Holden Gemini (TX-TG series), manufactured at Holden's Acacia Ridge plant in Brisbane. The Gemini became Australia's favourite 4-cylinder car for a decade. Holden also relied entirely on Isuzu for its commercial vehicles: the Isuzu KB became the Holden Rodeo in 1980, followed by the TF Rodeo in 1988 and RA Rodeo in 2003, which became staples of the Australian building trades and farming sectors. Similarly, the Isuzu Trooper was marketed as the Holden Jackaroo from 1981 to 2003.

When GM and Isuzu ended their light-commercial joint venture in 2008, Isuzu established Isuzu UTE Australia (IUA) as an independent factory distributor headquartered in Brisbane. IUA launched the D-MAX utility in 2008, powered by the legendary 3.0L 4JJ1 commercial truck-derived turbo-diesel engine. Renowned for cast-iron cylinder block durability, timing chain reliability, and effortless towing, the D-MAX earned unmatched trust among outback caravanners and trades.

In 2013, IUA launched the MU-X, a 7-seat 4WD wagon based on the D-MAX chassis. The MU-X became Australia's #1 selling ute-based SUV outside Toyota. In 2020, the third-generation D-MAX and second-generation MU-X arrived, introducing standard 5-star ANCAP safety, advanced driver assist systems (IDAS), and the refined 4JJ3-TCX engine, consistently ranking among Australia's top three best-selling utes.

models.overview: The Isuzu D-MAX is an Australian commercial and recreational ute powerhouse. Renowned for its commercial truck-derived 3.0-litre 4JJ-series turbo diesel engine, 3,500kg braked towing capacity, and unbreakable durability, the D-MAX grew from an independent newcomer in 2008 into the third best-selling vehicle outright in Australia.

d-max.name: D-MAX
d-max.overview: The Isuzu D-MAX is an Australian commercial and recreational ute powerhouse. Renowned for its commercial truck-derived 3.0-litre 4JJ-series turbo diesel engine, 3,500kg braked towing capacity, and unbreakable durability, the D-MAX grew from an independent newcomer in 2008 into the third best-selling vehicle outright in Australia.
d-max.australian_market_notes: Launched in late 2008 following the separation of Isuzu from the General Motors-Holden Rodeo joint venture, Isuzu UTE Australia established itself as an independent force. The D-MAX won fierce loyalty among caravanners, grey nomads, tradies, and outback tourers due to the under-stressed, gear-and-chain driven 4JJ1 engine. In 2020, the RG generation revolutionized ute safety by introducing the full IDAS safety suite and a centre airbag, earning a 5-star ANCAP rating across every single cab and chassis derivative, topped by the Walkinshaw-engineered Blade flagship in 2024.

generations.summary: Inaugural standalone model from Isuzu Ute Australia. Featured the commercial-grade 3.0L 4JJ1-TC turbo diesel (120kW/360Nm) with steel timing gears and dual-range 4WD.
